sources.title: Dreh’n wir mal das Radio an: Das Radio-Jahrhundert, die ersten 50 Jahre, 1923-1973
sources.creator: Jens-Uwe Völmecke
sources.researchNote: The note on the 1930 Homocord record sets out his working life: a singer heard on hundreds of records from 1928 until his death in 1945 during a tour entertaining the troops, often paired with the dance orchestra of Fred Bird, in private life Felix Lehmann. It also names two recording pseudonyms, Fred Lustig, under which he sings on the Odeon disc gathered here, and Ludwig Bernhuber, which no other record consulted for him gives. The portrait on the facing page is captioned with his name alone and is not dated by the publication; it is placed about 1930 from the record beside which it is printed.

media.title: Luigi Bernauer — studio portrait, about 1930
media.description: Studio portrait in profile of the singer and actor Luigi Bernauer, reproduced beside the entry on his Homocord record of 1930 with the Fred Bird Rhythmicans. A small emblem of a radio tower above a low hall is printed in the upper left corner; its lettering cannot be read at this size.
media.altText: Sepia studio portrait of a young man in profile, in a dark suit with a patterned tie.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The publication that reproduces the portrait names no photographer, giving only the private picture archives from which its illustrations come, and the edition itself was issued in 2024 with rights reserved. The local 568 × 793 pixel reproduction is used for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper performer, with the publication, the picture archives and the unresolved attribution stated alongside it.
